name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Adds a loading bar for slow federated starts: when a federated title is still black 1.5 seconds after play, a simple bar at the bottom shows a projected countdown, why it is taking a while, and a fun fact (settings LoadingOverlay and LoadingFunFacts; facts are fetched by the server, with a built-in fallback). Measures each friend's connection speed daily, when a server is added, and when one comes back online (Jellyfin peers and Plex) to power the projection. Adds timing logs for slow upstream responses and media-source resolution, and an admin diagnostic for Plex transcoding. Bounds how much of a remote file ffmpeg analyses before starting (FastStartProbing, on by default; quality is unchanged). Titles whose source reports two streams with the same index now keep their stream info instead of triggering a slow first-play probe.
